name: Shepherd's Pie Skillet Mash
whyItWorks: Finely ground meat takes 80% of the mechanical work away from your stomach.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown lean ground beef, lamb, or turkey with garlic powder, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, and beef broth (thickened with 1 tsp cornstarch). Top with peeled mashed Yukon Gold potatoes and broil in the toaster oven for 3-4 minutes until golden.
